latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — scans source code for common security vulnerabilities and suggests fixes.

- Detects SQL injection, XSS, hardcoded credentials, insecure randomness, command injection, and sensitive info leaks
- Provides security scores and vulnerability reports
- Includes default guardrails to redact secrets, restrict fixes to only vulnerable code, and prevent external transmission of sensitive data
- Supports scan triggers in English and Chinese
